integrity: The source Example 1 one-dimensional weight enumerator is reproduced exactly. Every message subspace of the seven-dimensional code is then enumerated in reduced row-echelon form for every one of 36 spread-component pairs and all 49 outside normals per pair, totaling 51,528,204 subcode instances.
scientific_limitations: The result is finite and exact for the explicit m=6, r=2 Desarguesian model. It proves higher-support isospectrality across all 1764 outside-normal instances in that model, but does not assert permutation equivalence or a general formula for arbitrary m and r.
title: All optimal affine-half instances of Example 1 share one higher-support spectrum
